requirements.title: The last release with sandboxes
requirements.rationale: Go resolves a nested module only from a version tag, so a consumer pinned to the sandbox module needs one on the last commit that has it.

criteria.action: carry the four tags v0.9.1, codesearch/v0.9.1, sandbox/v0.9.1 and mcpserve/v0.9.1, all on the commit the removal branch starts from, whose tree still holds sandbox/go.mod
criteria.contract: for each of the four tags, `git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}` prints the removal's base commit; `git ls-tree --name-only sandbox/v0.9.1 -- sandbox/go.mod` prints sandbox/go.mod

criteria.action: name v0.9.1 as the last release with sandboxes and sandbox/v0.9.1 as the version to pin for them, give the root, codesearch/ and mcpserve/ tags as the tags of a release, and describe no image and no gateway
criteria.contract: the file holds sandbox/v0.9.1 in its statement of the last release with sandboxes; its tag commands name v<X>, codesearch/v<X> and mcpserve/v<X> and no sandbox/ tag; it has no section on an image, its workflow, its tags, its registry secrets, building it, or the gateway

requirements.title: Sandbox code and modules removed
requirements.rationale: Parley owns sandboxes now; code nobody uses is code someone still has to build, test and keep in step.

criteria.action: track no file under sandbox/, containers/agentkit-sandbox/, examples/sandbox/, examples/gateway/ or examples/harness/, no .dockerignore, and no /agentkit-sandboxd line in .gitignore
criteria.contract: `git ls-files sandbox containers/agentkit-sandbox examples/sandbox examples/gateway examples/harness .dockerignore` prints nothing; `grep -x /agentkit-sandboxd .gitignore` exits 1

criteria.action: list exactly the modules ., codesearch, mcpserve and examples/indexedsearch in MODULES, each of which builds and vets for every cross target and for the host
criteria.contract: the Makefile line reads `MODULES := . codesearch mcpserve examples/indexedsearch`; TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet and TestHostCgoBuildAndVet pass over those four modules

setup: the go toolchain, with cross compilation for linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64
go test run without -short, as make check-release runs it; that run is the owner's, not the implementer's
check.pseudocode: in internal/policy/builds_test.go, unchanged: modules(t) reads the four directories from the Makefile's MODULES; TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet runs `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` in each for every cross target, TestHostCgoBuildAndVet for the host with cgo; both pass. Under -short (make check) both skip, so the implementer runs `go build ./... && go vet ./...` in each of the four modules and asserts exit 0

criteria.action: for any go.mod in the repository, require neither github.com/gokrazy/rsync nor github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock, and require google.golang.org/grpc and google.golang.org/protobuf only as indirect requirements
criteria.contract: `go list -m all` in each of the four modules lists neither github.com/gokrazy/rsync nor github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock; every line of every go.mod that names google.golang.org/grpc or google.golang.org/protobuf ends in `// indirect`

criteria.condition: make tidy runs on the removal tree
criteria.action: leave every go.mod and go.sum as committed
keep no helper that only the removed code called, while toolconformance's case table stays and the tools package still runs it
criteria.contract: testutil.Tar, its test TestTarHoldsTheFilesInNameOrder and toolconformance's Tree.Tar are gone and no Go file calls them; TestToolsConformToTheSharedCaseTable passes

check.pseudocode: in tools/for_test.go: TestToolsConformToTheSharedCaseTable, unchanged but for its comment, builds tools.For over each toolconformance tree and runs every case of toolconformance.CaseNames(); all pass. `go vet ./...` in the root module passes with the two Tar helpers deleted

requirements.title: Build tooling without sandbox targets
requirements.rationale: A make target or a generated doc for a module that no longer exists fails the first person who runs it.

criteria.action: define none of the targets proto, build-containers, build-sandbox-container, sandbox-podman-test, sandbox-landlock-test, sandbox-gateway and sandbox-gateway-test, and none of the variables VERSION, COMMIT, BUILD_TIME, LDFLAGS, CONTAINER_REGISTRY, SANDBOX_IMAGE, SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG, SANDBOX_TEST_ENV, AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_GIT_URL, PROTO_DIR, PROTOC_GEN_GO and PROTOC_GEN_GO_GRPC
criteria.contract: `make help` lists none of those targets; `make proto` exits non-zero with make's `No rule to make target` message

criteria.action: write the generated docs of the root, codesearch and mcpserve modules only
criteria.contract: docs/generated/ holds no sandbox/ directory; after `make doc`, `git status --porcelain -- docs/generated` prints nothing

criteria.action: for any file under .github/workflows, keep it byte-identical to the removal's base commit

criteria.condition: make check runs at the root of the removal tree
criteria.action: run fmt, vet, lint and the short tests in each of the four remaining modules and pass

requirements.title: Docs and doc comments that say what is true
requirements.rationale: Steering treats an outdated doc as a regression, and a doc that still promises sandboxes sends a reader to code that is gone.

criteria.action: describe no sandbox module, provider, agent, gateway, sandbox image or proto target as part of AgentKit in README.md, examples/README.md, examples/codingagent/README.md, docs/DEPS.md, docs/cli.md, docs/api.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/guide.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/development.md and docs/releasing.md, with each one's Contents index matching its headings
criteria.contract: a case-insensitive search of those files for agentkit-sandboxd, agentkit-gateway, gatewayd, landlock, podman and `sandbox/`, and a case-sensitive one for a Go identifier of the sandbox package (`sandbox\.[A-Z]`), match only docs/releasing.md's statement of the last release with sandboxes; every Contents link in those files names a heading of the same file

criteria.action: hold no ruling and no allowlist row for google.golang.org/grpc, google.golang.org/protobuf, github.com/gokrazy/rsync or github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock, and name only the root and mcpserve modules as the modules its list covers
criteria.contract: no heading and no allowlist row of docs/DEPS.md names any of the four modules; the paragraph after the allowlist names neither the sandbox nor the sandbox/gatewayd module

criteria.action: say in one line that the repository ships no command-line program, with no section on agentkit-sandboxd, agentkit-gateway or regenerating the protocols
criteria.contract: the file holds its title and that one line, and no second-level heading

criteria.action: name no identifier, package or command of the removed module in the comments of workspace/workspace.go, guard/guard.go, mcpserve/doc.go, mcpserve/buildinfo.go, mcpserve/go.mod, internal/toolconformance/toolconformance.go and tools/for_test.go, and say that the shell guard is the only boundary on a host without a sandbox and that guard.AllowAll fits a process already inside an isolation boundary someone else owns
criteria.contract: those files match none of `sandbox\.[A-Z]` (a Go identifier of the sandbox package), `sandbox/`, IsolationContainer, IsolationMicroVM, NetworkNone, AgentInfo, agentkit-sandboxd and buildver; docs/generated/ equals the output of `make doc` over them

requirements.title: The decision recorded in an ADR
requirements.rationale: ADR 05 and ADR 06 describe rules for code that no longer exists; the reason it is gone belongs where the next reader looks for decisions.

criteria.action: hold docs/adr/08-leave-sandboxes-to-the-platform-that-runs-them.md with status Accepted, recording that the sandbox module was deleted whole, why (Parley owns sandboxes; PRD 10's rule), and the consequences: the shell guard is the only boundary on a host without a sandbox, v0.9.1 is the last release with sandboxes, examples/harness is gone until agentkit-tools replaces it, and build-sandbox-containers.yaml stays in .github/workflows
criteria.contract: the file opens with `# ADR 08: Leave sandboxes to the platform that runs them` and `- **Status:** Accepted`, and has the sections Context, Decision and Consequences, as ADRs 01 to 07 do

criteria.action: keep ADR 05 and ADR 06 with their bodies unchanged and a status line saying each is superseded by ADR 08, with a link to it
criteria.contract: each file's status line reads `- **Status:** Superseded by [ADR 08](08-leave-sandboxes-to-the-platform-that-runs-them.md)`; `git diff <base>` of each file changes that line only

execution_paths.title: A maintainer checks the tree after the removal

steps.action: runs `make check` at the root of the removal tree
runs fmt, vet, lint and the short tests in ., codesearch, mcpserve and examples/indexedsearch
runs `make doc` and `make tidy`, then `make help` and `make proto`
reports the working tree unchanged and lists no tracked file under the removed trees
searches the docs, the doc comments and every go.mod for the names of the removed module, and reads ADR 05, 06 and 08

real_components: the repository's docs and go.mod files
setup: a checkout of the removal branch with the v0.9.1 tags fetched, and <base> the commit the branch starts from
provider credentials scrubbed from the environment (env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY), as for any run of the tests
end_state: make check exits 0, having run in exactly the four modules MODULES lists
`make doc` and `make tidy` leave `git status --porcelain` empty, and docs/generated/ holds no sandbox/ directory
`make help` lists no removed target and `make proto` fails with `No rule to make target`
`git ls-files sandbox containers/agentkit-sandbox examples/sandbox examples/gateway examples/harness .dockerignore` prints nothing and .gitignore has no /agentkit-sandboxd line
`go list -m all` in each module lists neither rsync nor go-landlock, and every go.mod line naming grpc or protobuf ends in `// indirect`

the search of REQ-4.1's files and REQ-4.4's comments for the removed names matches only docs/releasing.md's statement of the last release with sandboxes; docs/DEPS.md names none of the four removed dependencies; docs/cli.md is its title and one line
docs/adr/08-leave-sandboxes-to-the-platform-that-runs-them.md exists with status Accepted, and ADR 05 and ADR 06 differ from <base> only in a status line pointing to it
smoke.pseudocode: a shell session, not a committed test (steering forbids tests of artefacts): `env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY make check`; assert exit 0 and that its `go test -short ./... (<m>)` lines name exactly the four modules; `make doc && make tidy && git status --porcelain` is empty; `make help | grep -Ei 'sandbox|gateway|container|proto'` is empty; `make proto` exits non-zero; `git ls-files <removed paths>` is empty; for m in the four modules: `(cd $m && go list -m all) | grep -E 'gokrazy/rsync|go-landlock'` is empty; `grep -hE 'google.golang.org/(grpc|protobuf) ' $(git ls-files '*go.mod') | grep -v '// indirect'` is empty; `git diff --stat <base> -- .github/workflows` is empty; `grep -niE 'agentkit-sandboxd|agentkit-gateway|gatewayd|landlock|podman|sandbox/' <REQ-4.1 docs> <REQ-4.4 files>` and `grep -nE 'sandbox\.[A-Z]' <the same files>` match only the releasing.md statement, so prose such as 'not a sandbox.' is not a match; `git diff <base> -- docs/adr/05-* docs/adr/06-*` changes one status line each

execution_paths.title: A pinned consumer finds the last release with sandboxes

steps.action: reads docs/releasing.md and finds v0.9.1 named as the last release with sandboxes
shows the tagged tree, which holds sandbox/go.mod, on the commit the removal follows

setup: a checkout of the removal branch with the tags fetched from origin (`git fetch --tags origin`), and <base> the commit the branch starts from
end_state: docs/releasing.md names v0.9.1 as the last release with sandboxes and sandbox/v0.9.1 as the version to pin, and its tag commands name no sandbox/ tag
v0.9.1, codesearch/v0.9.1, sandbox/v0.9.1 and mcpserve/v0.9.1 each resolve to <base>
smoke.pseudocode: a shell session: `grep -n 'sandbox/v0.9.1' docs/releasing.md` matches the statement; for t in v0.9.1 codesearch/v0.9.1 sandbox/v0.9.1 mcpserve/v0.9.1: assert `git rev-parse $t^{commit}` == <base>; assert `git ls-tree --name-only sandbox/v0.9.1 -- sandbox/go.mod` == 'sandbox/go.mod'
